_doc: Global level ladders (PLAN §0.5: one wall, one road — a level belongs to the whole game and changes EVERY piece of that kind at once, the ones already standing too, with one subtle look change). M4 owns `wall` and `tower.*`; M9/M10 add the rest (road, bridge, rail, producers, housing, batteries, vehicles). Each level row says which research.json row raises it (`research`; level I needs none). Wall: `hp` per 4 m section, `mat` = the cell material every wall cell becomes (so fire follows the material: timber burns, stone does not), `acid` = share of acid damage that gets through, `regen` = hit points a section mends by itself every second, `glow` = Glow each wall cell gives off, `towersOn` = towers may stand on the wall, `trim` = the edge paint the scope draws on every wall at this level.

towers._doc: One ladder per tower kind (`tower.<id>` in sim.levels). Multipliers per level are in towers.json perLevel.
